---
title: "Methylation"
output: html_document
date: "2024-12-05"
---

Read methyl reference
```{r}
ref = readRDS("../../starting_kit_phase2-3/data/reference_pdac.rds")
methyl = ref[["ref_met"]]
```

Read RDS file
```{r}
ref_modules = readRDS("ref_modules.rds")
```

Groundtruth vs MEmatrix 
```{r}
methyl <- methyl[,order(colnames(methyl)),  drop = FALSE]
ref_modules <- ref_modules[,order(colnames(ref_modules)), drop = FALSE]
```

Compute association
```{r}
source("src/environment_set.R")
corr_matrix = compute.modules.relationship(t(ref_modules), t(methyl), "Groundtruth-Methyl_Modules", width = 8, height = 20, pval = 1, return = T)
ref = corr_matrix[[1]] + abs(min(corr_matrix[[1]]))
ref = minMax(ref)
saveRDS(ref, "ref_modules.rds")
```
